How valet parking works at Munich Airport

Valet parking at Munich Airport removes the need to find a parking space or move your luggage onto a shuttle bus. This meet-and-greet parking service lets you hand over your keys at the terminal and focus on your journey.

1 Reserve your valet parking online

Select your travel dates and book your preferred offer with the booking partner. Most providers offer a choice between covered parking and more affordable outdoor spaces. Your booking confirmation includes the agreed handover time, meeting point and your valet provider's contact details.

2 Follow your booking instructions on arrival

On your departure day, drive to the confirmed meeting point to hand over your vehicle. Some providers also ask you to call around 20 to 30 minutes before you arrive. Your booking confirmation explains the exact procedure.

3 Hand over your vehicle at the meeting point

A driver will meet you and take your car to the parking space you booked. The vehicle's condition and mileage are usually recorded at handover.

4 Go straight to check-in

The driver takes your car to your booked outdoor space or covered parking facility. You take your luggage directly to the departure area, leaving you free to concentrate on your flight.

5 Collect your vehicle after landing

After landing, follow your valet provider's return instructions. Your car is brought to the agreed meeting point within a few minutes so you can continue your journey home without a shuttle transfer.

Private valet services versus Munich Airport's own valet parking

On valet-parken-flughafen-muenchen.de you will find detailed offers and comparisons of local valet providers around Munich Airport. Private services broaden your choice with off-site outdoor parking, different comfort levels and a range of prices.

If you are looking for lower-cost parking, an outdoor space may be a good option. For greater protection from the weather and proximity to the airport, many private providers also offer indoor or underground parking.

The benefits of valet parking at Munich Airport

No searching for parking before your flight

Searching for a space, paying for terminal car parks and walking long distances need not be part of your trip. You hand over your keys directly outside the terminal entrances, and your parking space is reserved when you book online.

No shuttle transfer with luggage

Outdoor parking near Munich Airport often involves a shuttle transfer. With valet parking, a driver takes your vehicle to the parking space you booked. You avoid shuttle journeys with luggage or children and can go straight to check-in.

Less time pressure before departure

Valet parking is the most time-saving parking option at Munich Airport. Without a parking search or shuttle journey, you need to allow less time for parking, reducing pressure when terminals are busy and security queues are long.

Start your journey home promptly

After landing, waiting for a shuttle or walking to a terminal car park may be the last thing you want to do. With valet parking, a driver brings your vehicle back to Munich Airport so you do not have to arrange a transfer.

Ideal for business travellers and families

Valet parking at Munich Airport is well suited to travellers who value short walking distances and a predictable process more than the lowest parking rate. The convenience and time saved can make organising your trip considerably easier.

Munich Airport valet parking to suit your needs

Valet providers at Munich Airport differ in their parking facilities, additional services and reputation. To make an informed choice, consider three key factors: safety, convenience and price.

Safety

A documented vehicle condition, clearly identified parking locations and transparent key-storage arrangements are important features of a good valet service. Controlled access, fencing and lighting help protect outdoor parking areas. Some underground and covered car parks also provide security staff or camera surveillance.

More about safety

Convenience

The on-site process, service hours and timely vehicle return determine how convenient valet parking is. Many Munich Airport providers offer extras such as EV charging, hotel partnerships, car washing or maintenance services. These options can be particularly relevant for business travel.

Price

Valet parking at Munich Airport usually includes a basic charge for collecting and returning the vehicle, while parking is charged by the day. Check for overnight surcharges, delay fees and optional extras, which should be clearly stated when you book.

Munich Airport valet parking: frequently asked questions

Where do I hand over my vehicle?

Your provider gives you the exact meeting point in your booking confirmation. Depending on the valet service booked, the handover takes place in the departures area at Terminal 1 or Terminal 2. Always follow your provider's confirmed directions to avoid delays or misunderstandings.

How much time should I allow for handover?

Allow around 10 to 15 minutes to hand over your keys at Munich Airport. A brief vehicle inspection is usually carried out. The driver then takes your car to your reserved parking space while you head to check-in or security.

Do I need to call before arriving at the airport?

A call is not always necessary because the meeting point is confirmed when you book. Some providers do ask you to call around 20 to 30 minutes before arrival to help them plan. If required, this will be stated in your booking confirmation.

Where is my car parked while I am away?

Your valet provider takes your vehicle to a nearby parking facility around Munich Airport, selected when you book. Depending on the operator, you can choose underground, covered or outdoor parking.

What happens if my return flight is delayed?

If your flight is delayed, you can contact the operator by phone. Many providers also monitor flight times and are available 24/7 to coordinate vehicle return after an unexpected late arrival. The provider's terms govern cancellations, extra parking days and late collection for reasons within your control.

Are there surcharges for overnight handovers?

Some offers include overnight surcharges outside normal service hours. All additional charges must be clearly communicated before you complete your booking.

Can I book valet parking at short notice?

Last-minute booking is possible if your preferred provider still has availability for your dates. During holidays and busy travel weekends, booking earlier generally gives you a wider choice of offers.

What documents do I need at handover?

Your booking confirmation and car key are usually sufficient. Depending on the provider, have your vehicle registration document and driving licence available too. If the car belongs to a company or someone else, written authorisation may be required.

Munich Airport Valet Parking Prices

Private valet parking at Munich Airport starts at around €90 to €190 for eight days. The total has two components: the valet charge for collecting and returning your car, and the parking charge for your stay. Compare prices and obtain a quote for your travel dates from the booking partner.

Compare valet parking prices in Munich

These prices include parking and the valet service charge. Your total depends on your travel dates, handover times and chosen parking type. Booking-partner prices may differ from the operator's direct rate.

We may receive a commission if you book through a partner link. This does not increase the price you pay.

How much does the valet service cost on top of parking?

Where the service charge is shown separately, collecting and returning your car costs between €30 and €70. Parkservice Flieger charges €30 for the valet service. Munich Airport charges €35 for collection and €35 for return.

Parking charges are additional in these cases. Many private providers offer parking and valet service at a single package price.

What additional charges may apply?

Pay particular attention to your handover times when booking. Valet Service Clean charges an overnight supplement of €25 per drop-off or collection between 23:00 and 06:00. If both fall within this period, the total supplement is €50.

Extra parking days, car cleaning or EV charging can also increase the price. Check the amendment and cancellation terms for your chosen offer.

American Express valet parking in Munich: costs

With an eligible American Express Platinum Card, you can book Munich Airport's valet service through your card benefit. American Express provides access to the benefit; Flughafen München GmbH operates the service.

The Amex PDF for Munich lists €44 for vehicle collection and return together, plus parking charges at the budget rate. Check the current prices and conditions before booking on the Amex valet parking page.

pages.title: Is Valet Parking Safe?
pages.content:
Is Valet Parking Safe?

With valet parking, you entrust your vehicle to a parking service. Recording its condition, insurance for transfer journeys, protected parking areas and secure key storage all contribute to safety. We explain which measures matter and what you can check before booking.

Book a Munich valet parking provider

How safe is valet parking? Key points to consider

Safety depends on more than the parking space itself. Here are the main points to consider and the measures providers can take to make their valet service safer.

Documented vehicle handover

Record your vehicle's condition together with the driver. The handover report should note existing damage, mileage and fuel or battery level. Additional photos provide a clear reference for collection and help resolve questions later.

Insurance for transfer journeys

A member of staff drives your car between the terminal and the parking facility. Even on a short journey, accidents or damage cannot be ruled out. The provider should therefore have insurance that covers these transfers. If the information is unclear, ask about the scope of cover and any excess payable in the event of an accident.

Security at the parking facility

Your choice of parking space also matters. Outdoor parking areas should prevent unauthorised access through barriers, fences or walls. Security staff and camera surveillance can provide additional protection. To help protect your car from hail, storms and other weather, consider underground or covered parking. These spaces generally cost more but offer greater protection from the elements.

Secure storage of your car key

Only authorised staff should be able to access your key. Locked key cabinets or safes with a clear link between each key and vehicle are suitable options. Keys should be kept securely in an office, ideally away from the parking area itself.

Check your vehicle on collection

Inspect your car before leaving the meeting point. Compare the bodywork, wheels and interior with your photos, and check the mileage and fuel or battery level. If you notice any difference, tell the member of staff immediately and photograph any damage.

Can the valet service move my car?

As part of the booked valet service, your car may be driven to its parking space and moved within the site when operationally necessary. The terms should explain which journeys are included. Any unexpected additional mileage should be discussed on collection and checked against the handover report.

Optional services such as refuelling, maintenance, car washing or EV charging may involve journeys beyond the transfer between the terminal and parking space. Agree these journeys with the provider and check that the mileage is within the expected range when your car is returned.

Important: remove valuables from your vehicle

Even if the provider is reputable and the site is well secured, always remove valuables before handing over your keys. Personal belongings such as wallets, documents, jewellery, watches or cash are generally not included in the insurance cover and may not be compensated if lost.

Who is liable for damage during valet parking?

In principle, the party that causes damage and is legally responsible for it is liable. In practice, this depends on when the damage occurred and which insurance applies. If you find scratches, dents or interior damage, document them at the meeting point and obtain written confirmation that you reported them to the provider.

Frequently asked questions about valet parking safety

Will my car be parked on airport grounds?

Private valet services collect your vehicle at the terminal and then take it to an off-site parking area. The handover location therefore does not identify where your car will be parked. Check the parking location stated in your booked offer.

Are private valet services approved by Munich Airport?

Private valet services are not specifically inspected or approved by Munich Airport simply because they collect vehicles at the terminal. The provider you book is responsible for insurance, secure parking and proper delivery of the service.

Is indoor parking always safer than outdoor parking?

Covered parking offers extra protection from the weather. However, access controls, surveillance, staff and secure key storage are equally important in preventing unauthorised access. A well-secured outdoor space can therefore sometimes be a safer choice than an inadequately secured indoor facility.

When is valet parking a safe choice?

Valet parking safety does not depend on a single feature. A camera at the parking site is of limited value if the handover is not documented or it is unclear who holds your keys. Assess the whole process rather than the most prominent security claim. Choose an offer with protection appropriate to your car and your needs. A monitored indoor facility may suit a high-value or weather-sensitive vehicle, while a well-secured outdoor space with a documented handover may be sufficient for another car.

pages.title: About Us
pages.content:
About Us

We are a specialist information and comparison website for valet parking at Munich Airport. Our aim is to help travellers choose a suitable parking service and understand how it works before booking.

Valet parking relies on convenience and trust: you hand over your car at the airport, a driver takes it to a parking space, and it is returned when you arrive back. That is why we consider not only price but also parking facilities, the handover process, published security features, service hours and optional extras.

How we compare valet parking offers

Our website brings together offers from different parking operators and booking platforms, highlighting differences that a price-only comparison can overlook.

An outdoor space can be a practical, affordable option. Other travellers prioritise covered parking, flexible vehicle handover or extras such as EV charging and car care. We present the available information to help you find the offer that matches the level of convenience you want.

Where our information comes from

Our information is based on the published offer descriptions of parking operators and booking platforms. This includes services, parking features, opening hours, prices and customer reviews.

We do not currently carry out our own on-site inspections or award our own quality seals. Ratings are based on public customer reviews and identify their source. The binding prices, services and terms are always those displayed by the booking partner before you complete your reservation.

How this website is funded

Some links on this website are affiliate links. If you make a booking through one of them, we may receive a commission from the booking partner. This does not increase the price you pay.

This income helps us run the website, organise offer information and provide further content about valet parking. The services you can access directly through our website also depend on the offers available from our connected booking platforms.

Who provides the valet service?

The valet parking service at Munich Airport including vehicle collection, parking and return, is provided by the parking operator named in the offer. Your reservation is made with the booking partner shown, where you can review the binding services and contractual terms before booking.
